MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
SUBJECT : Japanese Overseas Radiotelephone Service
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 311.3 (6 Dec 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1830, dated 6 December 1947, subject same as above, as amended.
2. Radiotelephone calls between Japan and the points listed in inclosure 1 attached hereto, via the United States, are authorized, effective 1 May 1948.
3. All previsions of SCAPIN 1830/2 applicable to calls between Japan and the points listed in inclosure 1 thereto will apply equally to calls between Japan and the points listed in inclosure 1 of this memorandum.
4. Reduced Sunday rates for calls between Japan and Switzerland are discontinued, effective immediately. Henceforth, rates for calls between Japan and Switzerland will be the same on Sundays as on week days. Inclosure 1 of SCAPIN 1830/2 is amended accordingly.
5. Direct communication between the Civil Communications Section or the General Accounting Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Communications, regarding operating and accounting procedures within the scope of this memorandum, is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R. M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
